narrative.details:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on zephras with us vanished several centuries ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the Windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw Windstones scattered around the grove, think you can help me harvest them?
narrative.objectives: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade.windstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.

mentionedItems.name: Windstone
tooltip: Use: Restores 21 to 59 mana and 32 to 88 health. This item cannot be used outside of Skywall. (2 Min Cooldown)
"A small glowing stone empowered with the magical essence of Skywall. It is often used as both a currency and a source of magical energy on Zephras Isle."
